definitions.explanation: Eating food between main meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner), often referring to casual eating of snacks.

examples.japanese: {間食|かんしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}えている→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧。
⟦ダイエット→ダイエット：17678_daietto⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{間食|かんしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けた→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: It's better to avoid snacking while dieting.

examples.japanese: 3⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{間食|かんしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧ (between, interval) + {食|しょく} (eating) - eating during intervals between meals.

USAGE:
Often discussed in health and diet contexts. In Japanese culture, 3⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おやつ→おやつ：17921_oyatsu⟧ (3 o'clock snack time) is traditional, especially for children.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {間食|かんしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to snack
- {間食|かんしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧ - to cut back on snacking
- {間食|かんしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|や}める→止む：01153_yamu⟧ - to stop snacking
